content.title: SpaceX rival AST SpaceMobile's big contract, Rocket Lab upgraded
content.description:
Yahoo Finance anchor Josh Lipton tracks Friday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Shares of AST SpaceMobile (ASTS), rival of SpaceX (SPAX.PVT), are climbing after the company announced it will be working with the US Missile Defense Agency Shield program.

Rocket Lab (RKLB) was upgraded to Overweight from Equal Weight by Morgan Stanley analysts.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
